name: Mukhyamantri Satat Aajivika Yojna
benefit: Training programs will be organized for eligible women. Selected beneficiaries will get a scholarship of Rs 1,000/- during the training period. After the completion of the training, the beneficiaries will get a grant of up to Rs 50,000/-.
eligibility_rules: The beneficiary should be from the dependent, widow, and weak section. The age of the beneficiary should be between 18 years to 50 years. The beneficiary should be a native of Uttarakhand state. The beneficiary should not be benefited from similar business from any other scheme.
documents_required: Basic address proof. Aadhar card. Voter ID card. Ration magazine. Death Certificate / Divorce Certificate of
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Applicants can get the application form from the Women's Empowerment and Child Development Office. Fill out the application form carefully and submit it to the office along with all the necessary documents. The submitted application will be verified by the Women Empowerment and Child Development Department. After the clean verification, the applicant can avail the benefits of the scheme.
